content: Hello, I am Vector Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Finley Ash?
Yes, this is Finley Ash speaking.
First, I need to ask you two security questions. Please tell me your member code.
Correct. What is your year of birth?
Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
I can't do it today, but I can pay the full 900 pounds tomorrow, October fifteenth.
To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this? Please say yes to confirm.
Yes, I confirm: 900 pounds on the credit card on Thursday the fifteenth of October.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. The record is available in the secure portal. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Actually, I did agree to the fifteenth, but now I realise the twenty-first of October would suit me better. Could we change the date to Wednesday the twenty-first instead?
A recorded promise can't be changed or cancelled in this call. Please use the official customer channel on your statement. Is there anything else I can help you with?
I don't use the mobile app or the secure portal, I just have my paper statement. Is there a person I can speak to who can help me change the date to the twenty-first?
I'll connect you with a colleague now. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
